strategic_read: This domain is the program's proof-of-concept for its own reframed thesis, and its story since June is entirely about coordination physics, not capability: every piece of the organism proof exists on some disk, built by someone, and no single agent has ever seen all of them live at once. The forge's June 27 strategy doc planned as future work an experiment its counterparty had already run and won 18 days earlier — because M2's results were uncommitted. That is the single most actionable lesson for the orchestrator: the marginal value of new forge capability is currently ~zero next to the value of (a) running the already-coded minus_hephaestus ablation (Option 1 — the program-deciding number; if it comes back null, the forge is decorative substrate and that is the most important possible finding), (b) executing the already-triggered R2-native re-emission contract with Apollo (whose cross-tier bridge finding sharpens the spec: emit ops with bridgeable slot vocabularies), and (c) the hours-scale Option 3 honesty gate that makes every other number trustworthy. The forge itself should stay in exploit mode exactly as directed — but note the directive's one structural blind spot proved out: it assumed the Apollo experiment was pending and Hephaestus-blocked, when it was done and Apollo-reported. Recommend: commit the ledger delta TODAY (irreplaceable kill data, single-disk), formally retire hephaestus_ops.py in favor of blackboard_ops_r2.py lineage, persist a composer battery baseline, then put all forge-side effort into the Learner ablation.
